# Structured host readiness

RC3 uses `jbpa.host_readiness.run` for `jbpa validate`, INSTALL and REINSTALL. No infrastructure fields are required. Results remain RC schema 1.0, with the additive `details.preflight` section. Standalone validation accepts `--config`, optional `--version`, `--profile INSTALL|REINSTALL|HEALTH|UNINSTALL`, `--controlled-test` and `--dry-run`; INSTALL and REINSTALL are the mutation readiness profiles.

Each check reports PASS, WARN, FAIL, NOT_APPLICABLE or UNCONFIRMED, a blocking flag, interpreted reason, provider name, timestamp and bounded non-secret evidence. PASS means every blocking check passes; PASS_WITH_WARNINGS preserves nonblocking warnings/unconfirmed observations; FAIL includes any blocking FAIL or UNCONFIRMED. Unknown observations never become PASS. Standalone validate returns nonzero for FAIL. Dry-run reports a plan even if readiness is incomplete, and cannot authorize subsequent execution.

## Checks and exact behavior

- OS/version/codename/kernel/architecture are actual host observations compared with the configured target and support matrix. Ubuntu 22.04 runtime compatibility remains unqualified until live testing. amd64 normalizes to x86_64.
- Privilege checks effective UID and bounded `sudo -n true`. Mutation requires the caller to invoke JBPA as root; observed sudo capability does not cause automatic escalation. Dry-run records sudo availability as WARN.
- Package readiness checks dpkg/apt-get availability, readable dpkg status, bounded `dpkg --audit`, and nonblocking POSIX locks on existing apt/dpkg lock files. Locks are neither created nor deleted. Audit inconsistency, transaction contention and unconfirmed access are distinct outcomes.
- Repository readiness runs bounded `apt-get -s -o Debug::NoLocking=1 install odbcinst unixodbc unzip` using existing metadata. It performs no update, upgrade, download or package mutation. Successful simulation proves current metadata dependency resolution, not current repository network reachability. Actual dependency preparation retains the existing install gates.
- CPU/memory/disk capacity uses existing platform technical policy. The prior PA 12.10 Ubuntu 24.04 two-vCPU controlled QA exception remains nonblocking WARN and does not extend to Ubuntu 22.04.
- Root, /opt and /var filesystem checks record total/free/available bytes separately. Operational free-space allowance is max(4 GiB, 5 × observed package bytes + 1 GiB), evaluated on each relevant filesystem. This bounds package retention, extraction/runtime and evidence margin. For 12.10.1.1 the preserved 660,897,206-byte observation is available even in the release; inspected package size replaces it when available. This is a JBPA operational threshold, not vendor production sizing. Unknown future builds use the documented 4 GiB floor until actual inspection; no claim of vendor sizing is made.
- DNS runs an isolated resolver process with a five-second deadline for active configured artifact, Harmony and Key Vault endpoints. HTTPS HEAD probes have five-second connect and ten-second overall deadlines, verified TLS and no redirects/auth credentials. DNS, TCP and TLS failure reasons remain separate. HTTP 401/403 establishes unauthenticated reachability, not authentication success.
- `timedatectl show --property=NTPSynchronized --value` checks synchronization without selecting an NTP daemon. Unsynchronized or unavailable/unconfirmed synchronization blocks live execution. No clock or service is changed.
- Azure Key Vault uses the existing bounded IMDS and secret provider to authenticate, resolve configured registration fields and references, validate shapes and clear transient secrets. Results contain presence/availability classifications only. Identity attachment and RBAC are caller responsibilities. Other unavailable provider contracts remain blocking UNCONFIRMED.
- Existing package/root/user/process/credential-presence/register-input/PostgreSQL/commands/startup observations classify CLEAN_HOST, AGENT_INSTALLED_REGISTERED, AGENT_INSTALLED_UNREGISTERED or PARTIAL_INSTALL. Credentials contents are never read for classification. Ambiguous residual state is denied. Re-observation under the lifecycle lock guards REINSTALL against concurrent changes.

Agent Services reachability is UNCONFIRMED/nonblocking before registration because its authenticated product connection is proved by the existing initial-registration workflow. That workflow still requires Harmony authentication, Agent Services, synchronization and core connection-check health. This supplementary preflight outcome never substitutes for those gates.

Subprocess deadlines are 5 seconds for privilege/DNS/time, 10 seconds for audit, 30 seconds for repository simulation and 12 seconds for curl execution. Existing secret-provider deadlines are IMDS 5 seconds and Key Vault 10 seconds per reference. Snapshot package queries and baseline Support Tools probes also retain their existing bounded deadlines. Sequential checks have a finite sum; no retry loops or metadata refresh occur.
